hero.description: I'm Ademir Patrício, a designer and front-end developer with over 10 years in digital. My job is to find the right questions and turn the answers into a product with direction.

about.title: I learned to design by building and questioning.
about.content: I started in graphic design, moved through web and front-end, and today I work on digital products. I have worked in agencies, marketing teams and tech companies, from urban mobility to education. In every phase, the question was the same: where does this need to take people?

services.title: Where I can help on each project

productDesign.title: Product Design
productDesign.description: I start with the problem and only then open Figma. I design flows, prototype what needs testing and explain every decision.

frontEnd.title: Front-End
frontEnd.description: What I design, I know how to build. I use React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS and take each component from design to deploy.

designSystems.title: Design Systems
designSystems.description: I organize tokens, components and patterns so the product keeps moving in the same direction, even as the team grows.
